rv.q: Still, though the whole doesn’t quite pay off emotionally, the individual parts often have intelligent and clever elements that go beyond mere riffing on sci-fi scenarios, and the actors move with panache between the scenes.
As a whole, the ensemble juggles their various roles with aplomb, but they're constantly hampered by a script that feels too literal, too obvious, too direct in anything it's trying to say.
Despite the fact that I looked at my watch a half dozen times, I did not regret seeing this play, because some aspects are promising and there is an inkling of a plot.
